pages.text: Health 60, Armor 3, Knockback Resistance 1.0, Attack 10, Speed 0.25.$(br)An ice golem from a parallel world, and not quite the one you can raise yourself... A little study shows these golems are cheap and cheerful, and every bit as good at launching foes as an iron golem.
Place a $(l)Vitality Pumpkin$() on the centremost $(l)blue ice$().
You can build one, or call it quickly with a $(l:supreme/items/frostborn_focus)Frostborn Focus$(); right-click it with $(l)snow blocks$() or $(l)ice$() to heal it.
